purpose: One exact frozen P38 2023 replay/export, then complete descriptive cross-year attribution of the directly ablated Control trades.
source_authority: P38 V1R11, historical source b3142d0135d393088ab3fe55c53b0e28ec7574cb; exact execution observer SHA E96298B1E68F0BA4585BE2958E2E9EA984F4877902AC5E7669DB7ABB2B358096
replay_change: Output-only capture after existing external_full_adaptive_replay returns; unchanged return object and trading function AST.
market_access: Frozen P38 scope only: pre-2024 source history for warmup and ROBUSTNESS_2023 signals. PyArrow timestamp < 2024-01-01 UTC selector. No 2024/2025 rows materialized or analyzed.
direct_set: Control event_key intersect treatment trace decision TRANSITION_ADMISSION_ABLATED, then assert entry_market_state TRANSITION. Never select by realized outcome or exit state.
accounting_decompositions: Mean PnL = win_probability*mean_win + (1-win_probability)*mean_nonwin. Symmetric Shapley decomposition across these three descriptive factors; zeros count as nonwins.
Common symbols: symmetric count and within-symbol mean decomposition; exclusive symbols reported separately. Descriptive composition accounting, not proof of market causal effects.
limitations: Direct set is frozen path-dependent P19 intervention mapping, not all TRANSITION entries
Cash PnL depends on sizing; normalized net_pnl/entry_notional reported as diagnostic only
No independent entry-component causal effect is inferred from association
No MFE/MAE reconstruction unless already frozen and valid
failure: Any replay/parity failure: FAIL_CLOSED, NO_SCIENTIFIC_CONCLUSION, no alternate replay semantics.
classification: Evidence-supported families from user taxonomy; no invented numerical cutoff for a family, no scoring or runtime rule.
